DGP.responses: independent Bernoulli conditional on theta; existing p6 simulate()

seeds.reason: New Q4 stream, no repeated p6 data batches

estimation.implementation: public 2PL equality constraints, all12 a tied/free; theta mean0 variance1 fixed

SE_CI.basis: select ONE declared shared-a representative plus12 difficulties, retain all cross-covariances; no pseudoinverse
SE_CI.deduplication: Shared-a one CI per dataset, never12 independent copies
SE_CI.bounds: Any common-a fit with a/b at library bounds within existing1e-6 rejected for all Wald CI
SE_CI.information: Finite positive-definite independent covariance, condition<=1e8; true singularity rejected

criteria.scope: All13 distinct coordinates AND pooled b block must pass; no cherry-picking coordinates

precision_planning.note: Planning does not guarantee precision. Evaluate observed replication-cluster ratio MCSE, never extend R after seeing results.

coverage.coordinate: covered / eligible for EACH distinct a,b_j
coverage.pooled_b: sum covered difficulties / sum eligible difficulties; replication-cluster delta MCSE from existing coverage_precision
coverage.all_parameters_pooled: descriptive only, a once; cannot replace any coordinate gate
coverage.effective_sample_size: p(1-p)/cluster_MCSE^2; also report independent dataset count and eligible clusters
coverage.failure_sensitivity: Coverage lower=covered/R and upper=(covered+ineligible)/R; both must remain in[.93,.97] for coordinate certification; failures never silently removed

uncertainty.pooled: replicate-cluster delta/t interval, NOT iid interval CP
uncertainty.bias: mean error and replication MCSE; RMSE and average SE / empirical SD
uncertainty.multiple_coordinates: Bonferroni95% simultaneous exact Clopper-Pearson intervals across13; point+MCSE gates unchanged, no equivalence claim from unadjusted intervals

failure_policy.nonconvergence: record estimates if finite; CI ineligible
failure_policy.point_bias: all converged finite estimates, independently of CI availability
failure_policy.checkpoint: durable claim before dataset generation; atomic result per seed. On resume completed seeds reused; claimed-but-incomplete seeds recorded INTERRUPTED/unknown, never refitted

stopping: Fixed4300. No interim statistical decisions, optional stopping, seed selection, post-result tolerance changes or repeat campaign. Resource interruption preserves all records.
reference: Existing native free-SD Rasch point equivalence reused; new deterministic fixture SE/full-Jacobian check in preflight.json. No new R refits.
outcome: CERTIFIED only if every preregistered gate and required CI pass; otherwise PARTIAL or NOT CERTIFIED with exact failures. No other DGP/model extrapolation.
pre_execution_revision: Before any campaign result: explicit outside-box/label validation; original design and statistical thresholds unchanged.
